title: Parent notifications (Telegram)
description: Messages to parents via the Telegram bot: “arrived / left / absent” and the excuse result. For now it works only in the selected pilot schools.

bot.title: Telegram bot
bot.envHint: Enter the token and address in the “Telegram bot connection” card on the System settings page.
bot.publicUrlHint: Enter the token and address in the “Telegram bot connection” card on the System settings page.

schools.title: Connected schools
schools.description: Parents can connect to the bot and receive automatic messages (arrived, left, absent) only for students of these schools. You can turn on all schools with one button. The “absent” message is sent once after the shift start plus the grace time (for classes without a shift, at the default time).
schools.photosConfirmText: Photos taken by the terminal when students of “{{name}}” enter or leave will be shown to parents in the Mini App. These are pictures of the child at the school entrance, so the school management’s and parents’ consent is required. Continue?
schools.enableAllText: Parent messages about absence and entry/exit will be turned on for every school in the system. Settings of schools already configured stay as they are, and terminal photos stay off. Continue?

broadcast.title: Message parents
broadcast.description: Announcements and other messages are sent to parents through Telegram. Only parents connected to the bot who have not turned announcements off will receive them.
broadcast.languageHint: The Uzbek text is required. Where there is no text in another language, parents receive the Uzbek one.
broadcast.subject: Title (optional)
broadcast.reach: {{count}} parents will receive it ({{children}} children, {{schools}} schools)
broadcast.reachHint: Parents who are not connected to Telegram or turned announcements off are not included.
broadcast.urgentNote: An important notice is sent immediately (night quiet hours are ignored).
broadcast.quietNote: Regular messages wait until morning between 21:00 and 07:00.
broadcast.confirmText: The “{{type}}” message will be sent to {{count}} parents. After sending, only messages not yet delivered can be canceled. Continue?
broadcast.cancelText: {{count}} messages not yet sent will be canceled. Messages already sent cannot be recalled.
